Drew: Chop the onions, Reese, before I decide to chop you instead.
Reese: Your breathing is so loud it’s vibrating the cutting board, just shut up.
Drew: I asked you to move, not to insult my patience while I try to get this done.
Reese: Move? You’re standing in my way like a brick wall with a temper.
Drew: If you value your eyes, you’ll step out of this kitchen right now.
Reese: Or what? You’ll yell? You’ve been yelling for twenty minutes and nothing changes.
Drew: Then get out, before I make sure you never cook in here again.

Jordan: I’m not going to pack another bag for your last-minute whim.
Riley: It’s not a whim, it’s a chance to actually breathe, unlike you.
Jordan: Breathe? I’ve been breathing through your incompetence all week.
Riley: Oh, now I’m the problem because you can’t handle five hours away?
Jordan: I can’t handle the fact that you never check if I’m even free.
Riley: You’re never free because you’re too busy building walls.
Jordan: At least my walls keep people like you out.

Alex: Don't you dare tell me you canceled the reservation.
Sam: I didn't just cancel it, Alex, I burned the bridge.
Alex: You have got to be kidding me, do you know how much effort I put into this?
Sam: Effort? You think I care about your precious little schedule right now?
Alex: This is the worst thing you have ever done to me, and I mean that.
Sam: Oh, spare me the drama, you're the one who made it impossible to stay calm.
Alex: I am done listening to your excuses, walk away from me right now.

Taylor: Look at this mess, you absolute idiot!
Jamie: Don't you dare talk to me like that, Taylor!
Taylor: I'm not talking, I'm screaming at you for ruining my engine!
Jamie: I told you I didn't touch the alternator, you lying bastard!
Taylor: Then why is there oil everywhere and your hands are dirty?!
Jamie: Maybe I was trying to help you instead of sitting there useless!
Taylor: Helping? You nearly caused a fire in my driveway!
Taylor: Get out of my sight before I make you walk home!

Alex: I told you we were not touching that account, and yet here we are.
Sam: Don't lecture me when you’re the one who forgot our agreement entirely!
Alex: I didn’t forget; you chose to ignore my warnings because you always do.
Sam: Ignoring? You call it ignoring when I try to fix the mess you created?
Alex: Fix it? You just made it exponentially worse with your selfish impulse!
Sam: At least I acted while you just sat there and watched the numbers drop.
Alex: Next time you spend our future, don't expect me to clean up your disaster.

Casey: I can’t believe they had the audacity to do that after everything we did for them.
Morgan: It’s not just audacity, Casey; it’s a blatant disregard for every promise they swore on their lives.
Casey: I’m still shaking, I can’t even look at my phone without feeling sick to my stomach.
Morgan: Same here, I’ve been pacing for an hour trying to find the words that don’t make me sound insane.
Casey: They think they can just walk away and pretend none of it happened? Please.
Morgan: Exactly, they’re playing games with people who actually gave a damn, and that’s unforgivable.
Casey: I’m done being polite, I’m going to make sure they hear exactly how we feel about this betrayal.

Taylor: Are you kidding me? I spent all night on this report and you just deleted it?
Jamie: I didn't delete it, you idiot, I moved it because it was cluttering the shared drive!
Taylor: You moved it? To the trash folder, Jamie! How am I supposed to get it back now?
Jamie: Just stop screaming at me, maybe then I could actually think of a solution instead of defending myself!
Taylor: I’m not screaming, I’m expressing my absolute frustration with your incompetence!
Jamie: My incompetence? You’re the one who didn't save a local copy, don't twist this around!
Taylor: Well, congratulations, you've made a huge mistake, so now we both fail, don't we?

Casey: I can’t believe he actually had the nerve to show his face at the party.
Morgan: You think that’s bad? He stole my project files before he even left the office.
Casey: I’m going to march right over there and scream until my throat bleeds.
Morgan: Don’t bother, I already told him exactly where he can shove his apologies.
Casey: He ruined everything we worked on for three years, Morgan, three years!
Morgan: And now I’m watching his career implode in real time, and I can’t look away.
Casey: Let him burn, but I’m making sure he doesn’t forget who lit the match.

Casey: I told you we weren't going out tonight, so why the hell is your coat on?
Morgan: Because I’m sick of sitting in this silence while you seethe over nothing.
Casey: Nothing? You walk over me all day and expect me to just smile?
Morgan: I expect you to respect my need for air, not your twisted narrative.
Casey: Get out then, before I say something that ruins us both.
Morgan: Oh, please, act like the victim, it’s your favorite role.
Casey: Don't you dare walk out that door unless you're never coming back.

Drew: Look at this mess! The whole radiator is blown, just like I knew it would be!
Reese: Oh, don't blame me, I told you not to ignore the warning lights for weeks!
Drew: I didn't have time to stop, and now we're stranded in the middle of nowhere!
Reese: Well, maybe if you weren't always rushing, we wouldn't be in this goddamn predicament!
Drew: Stop shouting at me, you think this is my fault? The mechanic was useless!
Reese: Useless? He was right to charge you, Drew, because you treat everything like garbage!
Drew: I am not listening to your excuses, I'm calling a tow truck and I'm leaving you here!

Drew: Did you see the way he slammed the door right before he hung up?
Reese: I saw it, and I wanted to scream until my throat bled.
Drew: He doesn't get to treat us like we’re invisible anymore.
Reese: No, he doesn't get to do that to either of us.
Drew: My hands are still shaking just thinking about his last sentence.
Reese: Mine too, because I’m done being polite to someone so cruel.
Drew: Then we don’t call back. We let him sit in that silence.
Reese: Exactly. Let him choke on his own arrogance.

Quinn: I told you we were leaving at six, so don't even think about showing up late again.
Avery: Oh, excuse me for having a life before I have to cater to your rigid schedule.
Quinn: Cater? I didn't ask you to cater, I asked you to respect the time we agreed on.
Avery: Respect? You’re the one who changes the destination every five minutes.
Quinn: I changed it once because your original plan was a disaster waiting to happen.
Avery: And whose fault was that for not checking the weather forecast like an adult?
Quinn: Maybe I should have just stayed home instead of wasting gas on this nonsense.
Avery: Then stay home! I’m not forcing you to come along.
Quinn: Fine, keep the rental car and rot in it for all I care.

Casey: They hung up on me after I didn't even finish speaking.
Morgan: That’s the second time this week they’ve treated me like I’m invisible.
Casey: I can’t believe they think they’re above basic courtesy.
Morgan: I’m done trying to explain myself to someone who refuses to listen.
Casey: If they want a war, they’ve got one, starting right now.
Morgan: I’m blocking their number and every other line of communication.
Casey: Let them try to reach out; they’ll get nothing but silence.

Quinn: Just tell me you’re not serious about booking that cabin, because I swear I will scream.
Avery: Oh, please, spare me the drama; you’re the one who forgot our anniversary last month.
Quinn: Don’t you dare bring that up when you’ve been ignoring my texts for three days!
Avery: I’ve been ignoring you because you treat every conversation like a hostage negotiation.
Quinn: I treat them like that because you never actually listen to a word I say.
Avery: Well, maybe if you stopped shouting, I might actually hear what you’re saying.
Quinn: Fine, let’s just cancel the whole thing and pretend we don’t exist anymore.
Avery: That sounds like a plan, really, because I can’t stand the sight of you right now.

Jordan: I can’t believe you’d even suggest that dump as a viable option.
Riley: It’s not a dump, it’s the only place we can actually afford without eating paste.
Jordan: So that’s your solution? We live in squalor because you’re too stubborn to look further.
Riley: I am not stubborn, I am the only one paying attention to the math!
Jordan: Your math is broken, just like everything else you do around here.
Riley: Don’t you dare insult my competence while we’re drowning in debt.
Jordan: I’m insulting the fact that you refuse to see the obvious truth.
Riley: The obvious truth is that you’re impossible to please.

Alex: You actually spent the rent money on that stupid car repair?
Sam: Don’t you dare raise your voice at me like I’m some kind of thief!
Alex: I’m not raising my voice; I’m screaming because we’re going to be homeless next month.
Sam: You always act like I’m the only one who makes mistakes in this house.
Alex: This isn’t about mistakes, Sam; it’s about you completely ignoring my warning.
Sam: Well, maybe if you hadn’t hidden the keys, I wouldn’t have had to rush and pay that fee.
Alex: So now it’s my fault you can’t keep your head above water?
Sam: I didn’t say that, but you sure are twisting everything I say.
Alex: Fine, keep your lies and take the eviction notice when it comes.

Casey: I’m done packing, I’m done pretending this is some great adventure, I’m done!
Morgan: Oh, so you’re the one who’s tired? After you refused to even look at the apartments I found?
Casey: Because I didn’t want to move to a city where I don’t know a single soul, but sure, play victim.
Morgan: This isn’t about you, Casey, it’s about us finally getting a fresh start somewhere that isn’t a dump.
Casey: A fresh start? You mean a fresh way to resent me for every dollar we spend?
Morgan: You always twist everything into something ugly just to keep us stuck in this miserable routine.
Casey: If I’m the problem, then take your boxes and go, I don’t care where you land.

Jordan: I’m done letting this place rot my life away, so pack your bags because we leave tonight.
Riley: W-wait, please, I can’t just leave everything behind without knowing where we’re going.
Jordan: It doesn’t matter where we’re going as long as it’s not here, so stop hesitating!
Riley: What if we get lost? What if there’s no job for me? I can’t handle another mistake.
Jordan: You’re not going to handle anything if you keep sitting on your hands while I burn bridges.
Riley: I’m shaking, Jordan, I don’t even know if I trust the person you’re becoming.
Jordan: Then trust that I’m the only one strong enough to save us from this suffocation.
Riley: Please, just calm down, I can’t breathe when you shout like that.

Alex: Just pick something, Sam. I’m done waiting for you to decide.
Sam: I... I don’t know, my hands are shaking too much to look at the phone.
Alex: Stop trembling! It’s just dinner, not a life-or-death situation.
Sam: Please, lower your voice, you’re scaring me.
Alex: Scaring you? You’re the one making this impossible!
Sam: I’m sorry, I’ll stay home, just please don’t yell.
Alex: Fine, you stay here. I’m leaving.

Quinn: You have five minutes to explain why the file is empty.
Avery: I-I didn’t mean to lose it, please don’t fire me.
Quinn: "Didn't mean to"? Do you know what this costs us?
Avery: My hands are shaking so hard I can’t even type the password.
Quinn: I don’t care about your hands; I care about the client losing faith in us.
Avery: Please, just give me ten more minutes, I’ll fix it right now.
Quinn: It’s not about fixing it anymore; it’s about your complete lack of respect.

Alex: Do you have any idea what kind of monster does this to someone?
Sam: Please, don’t say it so loud, they might hear us.
Alex: Hear us? They can hear me screaming from here, I’m so done with their excuses.
Sam: Shh, just... just lower your voice, I can feel the walls shaking.
Alex: Shaking? I’m shaking with rage, I want to tear this whole place apart.
Sam: No, no, please don’t move, if you stay still maybe they’ll pass by.
Alex: I am not hiding in the dark while that bastard gets away with it.
Sam: Alex, if you don’t quiet down right now, I think we’re both going to die.
Alex: Then let’s die standing up, I’m not letting this slide.

Quinn: Slamming his hand on the desk, he shouts, "Do you have any idea how many hours I lost because of that stupid typo?"
Avery: Trembling, she whispers, "I... I'm so sorry, I didn't mean to..."
Quinn: His voice rises to a dangerous volume, "Sorry doesn't fix the client's lawsuit, Avery!"
Avery: Tears welling up, she stammers, "Please, don't yell at me, I'll fix it right now."
Quinn: Pacing furiously, he snaps, "You say that every time, and every time it falls apart!"
Avery: Shrinking back, she pleads softly, "I'll work all night, just please let me make it right."
Quinn: Stopping abruptly, he glares, "It's too late for apologies, Avery."

Quinn: I don’t care how many times I asked for the file by noon, because it’s gone.
Avery: I-I can fix it, please just give me another hour, I swear I’m typing right now.
Quinn: An hour? You think the client is going to wait an hour for your incompetence?
Avery: I didn’t mean to lose it, my computer froze and I panicked, I’m so sorry.
Quinn: Sorry doesn’t restore the data, Avery, it just proves you’re careless.
Avery: I’ll stay here all night, I’ll rewrite everything from scratch, just don’t fire me.
Quinn: You’re not staying, you’re walking out that door and never coming back.

Quinn: Why is the knife block facing the wrong way? Do you even care about this house?
Avery: I... I was just going to fix it, I promise, please don’t yell.
Quinn: You always promise. And then I come home to chaos every single night.
Avery: It’s not chaos, I was just busy, I’m sorry, I’ll do it right now.
Quinn: You’re not listening. You never listen until I’m ready to scream.
Avery: I am listening, I’m trying, please don’t throw that plate.
Quinn: Fix it. Before I decide to break everything else in the room.

Taylor: Pack your bags, we’re leaving at dawn, and don’t you dare ask why.
Jamie: P-please, Taylor, just tell me what’s going on, I can’t do this blind.
Taylor: I told you to pack, so why are you still standing there shaking like a leaf?
Jamie: I’m trying to be brave, but I don’t know what you’re planning.
Taylor: You’ll know when we get there, now move your ass before I lose what little patience I have.
Jamie: I can’t go if I don’t know where we’re going, please, don’t make me do this.
Taylor: You don’t have a choice, Jamie, so zip your mouth and grab your coat.

Quinn: I told you this engine was shot, but you kept driving it like nothing was wrong!
Avery: I-I didn’t think... please, just stop shouting at me.
Quinn: Stop shouting? You’re the one who broke it again, just like last month!
Avery: I’m sorry, I’m really sorry, I’ll call the tow truck right now.
Quinn: A tow truck won’t fix your complete lack of common sense!
Avery: Please, Quinn, I’m scared you’re going to do something reckless.
Quinn: The only thing reckless here is you getting behind the wheel of this junk.

Casey: How could you possibly leave the server running over the weekend?
Morgan: I... I thought the auto-shutdown was scheduled, I swear I checked.
Casey: Checked? You didn't check, you guessed, and now we are paying for it.
Morgan: Please, Casey, just let me fix it, I’ll stay late, I’ll do whatever you need.
Casey: Whatever I need? You need to explain why your "guess" cost us a client.
Morgan: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, my hands are shaking, I don't know what else to say.
Casey: Then don't say anything, just get out of my sight before I lose it completely.

Quinn: Do you have any idea what time it is?
Avery: I... I couldn't get a hold of the driver, and my phone died.
Quinn: So you just decided to wait here? In the dark?
Avery: Please, Quinn, I was so scared to leave without you.
Quinn: You should have been scared of keeping me waiting an hour!
Avery: I didn't mean to upset you, I just wanted us to be safe together.
Quinn: Safety isn't worth your utter disregard for my time.
Quinn: Get in the car and don't speak until we reach the house.

Jordan: Put the knife down. Right now.
Riley: I... I just need to chop the onions, please.
Jordan: You think I’m joking? Look at my hands. They’re shaking.
Riley: I didn’t mean to... I’ll make it right, I promise.
Jordan: You never make it right. You just wait for me to leave.
Riley: Please don’t yell, my heart can’t take it.
Jordan: Then maybe you shouldn’t have brought that weapon into my kitchen.

Drew: You had one job, and you threw it in the trash!
Reese: I-I was just trying to help, please don't look at me like that.
Drew: Help? You called it help while my savings evaporated into thin air!
Reese: I thought you’d never notice, I didn’t know it would end up like this.
Drew: Don’t you dare make this about your ignorance, you stole from me!
Reese: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, just please don’t scream at me anymore.
Drew: Apologies don’t put the money back in my account, Reese.

Jordan: You have exactly three seconds to explain why this is not finished.
Riley: P-please, just give me an hour, I swear I can fix it.
Jordan: An hour? I’ve been waiting three days for your half of the work.
Riley: I know, I’m so sorry, the server crashed and I lost the files.
Jordan: Don’t you dare lie to my face when I know you didn’t back it up.
Riley: I didn’t mean to, please don’t fire me, I have kids.
Jordan: Your excuses are worthless, and your incompetence is absolute.
Jordan: Get out of my sight before I call security.

Jordan: I don't care where we go, just get in the car.
Riley: Please, don't shout at me like that, my hands are shaking.
Jordan: Then stop trembling and move, we are wasting time!
Riley: I can't think straight when you look at me like that.
Jordan: You think you have a choice right now?
Riley: I'm trying to breathe, please just lower your voice.
Jordan: Breathing won't fix what you did, so drive!

Drew: You had one job, Reese. One simple job, and you messed it up completely.
Reese: I-I tried, I swear, but the road was blocked and I didn't know what else to do.
Drew: You didn't think? You just froze while everything I built started to crumble?
Reese: Please, don't shout, I can't handle this, I'm shaking right now.
Drew: Handle it? You need to handle the fact that your incompetence just ruined everything.
Reese: I’ll fix it, I promise, just please stop looking at me like that.
Drew: Too late for promises. Get out of my sight before I lose what’s left of my restraint.

Taylor: I told you this was a mistake, and now look at the mess we’ve made.
Jamie: I can’t breathe in here, the walls feel like they’re closing in on us.
Taylor: You didn’t listen, you never listen, you just run when things get hard.
Jamie: Please, stop yelling, your voice sounds like it’s going to shatter the glass.
Taylor: Shatter? I’m done pretending everything is fine when it’s clearly falling apart.
Jamie: I’m shaking, Taylor, I don’t know what we’re supposed to do now.
Taylor: You’re supposed to stop hiding behind that fear and face what you did.
Taylor: We leave tonight, and if you don’t pack, you’re on your own.

Jordan: So that’s it? Just like that, they’re gone?
Riley: Please, Jordan, lower your voice, you’re shaking the whole room.
Jordan: I should have seen it coming, I should have done something!
Riley: They’re looking for me too, can’t you see how my hands are trembling?
Jordan: They don’t get to decide our fate, not without a fight.
Riley: There is no fight, only silence, and I’m suffocating here.
Jordan: Then breathe, because I’m going to tear their world apart.
Riley: You’ll kill us both, please, just stay back.

Drew: I don’t care if the boxes are heavy, just keep moving them.
Reese: My hands won’t stop shaking, I can barely lift the lid.
Drew: Then use your arms instead of your nerves, we’re running out of time.
Reese: What if we picked the wrong place? What if it’s all wrong?
Drew: There is no wrong, there is only staying or leaving.
Reese: I feel like I’m walking off a cliff blindfolded.
Drew: Then close your eyes and trust that I won’t let you fall.

Quinn: Just get out of the car before I decide to level this whole street.
Avery: P-please, Quinn, I didn't mean for it to happen, I swear.
Quinn: You swear? You think your little promises fix a destroyed engine?
Avery: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, please don’t hurt me.
Quinn: Sorry doesn’t turn the key, Avery, and you know that.
Avery: I’ll pay for it, I’ll sell everything, just stop yelling.
Quinn: Keep your money; I want you to feel every second of this mistake.

Jordan: I don’t care if the rent is cheaper, that neighborhood is a trap and I’m not walking into it.
Riley: Please, just... please listen to me, the walls are thick and it’s safe, I swear it is.
Jordan: Safe? You call that safety while the lights flicker like a dying heartbeat?
Riley: I’ll hold your hand, I promise I won’t let anything happen to you, just don’t look at me like that.
Jordan: Don’t touch me, don’t you dare breathe on me while you suggest I move into that hellhole.
Riley: I’m shaking so hard I can’t even stand, just say yes so I can stop feeling like this.
Jordan: Get out of my sight before I decide to burn the whole thing down myself.

Casey: Don't touch that knife unless you want to lose a finger.
Morgan: I-I just thought we could chop the onions together, like we always do.
Casey: Always? You’ve never been careful enough for "always."
Morgan: Please, Casey, I’m trying to help, I’m sorry if I moved too slow.
Casey: Sorry doesn't fix the mess you made of the counter an hour ago.
Morgan: I’ll clean it up right now, just please don’t raise your voice.
Casey: Clean it up? You should have been paying attention instead of staring at your phone.

Casey: I am going to burn that house to the ground.
Morgan: Please, don’t say that, they’re just people.
Casey: People? They stole everything I had left!
Morgan: Lower your voice, someone might hear you.
Casey: Let them hear! Let them all know what they did!
Morgan: I’m shaking, Casey, please just put the phone down.
Casey: I won’t stop until I see the smoke rising.

Drew: I’m not asking you if you want to go; I’m telling you we are leaving at dawn.
Reese: B-b-but the weather report says there’s a storm, Drew, please, just wait until Monday.
Drew: Monday is too late, and I don’t have time to listen to your excuses anymore.
Reese: I’m trying to keep us safe, don’t you see that? Please, don’t look at me like that.
Drew: Safe? You think sitting in this house while I rot away is keeping us safe?
Reese: I’m shaking so hard I can barely hold the phone, just calm down, I beg you.
Drew: Calm down? Look at my hands, Reese, they’re shaking because I’m done waiting for you to care.

Alex: You think you can just walk away from the debt? You think I’m stupid?
Sam: P-please, Alex, don’t shout. I was scared, I didn't know what else to do.
Alex: Scared? You were reckless! You gambled with everything we had!
Sam: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, please don’t hurt me, I’ll fix it, I promise!
Alex: Fix it? You broke it! You shattered it and now you want me to hold the pieces?
Sam: I’ll sell the car, I’ll get a second job, just please, stop yelling at me!
Alex: It’s too late for promises, Sam. The money is gone, and so is my trust.

Casey: They didn't just leave; they erased us, didn't they?
Morgan: Please, keep your voice down, I can’t handle the shouting right now.
Casey: How dare they think they can just vanish without a word!
Morgan: I’m shaking, Casey, I literally can’t stop my hands from trembling.
Casey: I’m going to tear their lies apart piece by piece until the truth bleeds out.
Morgan: What if they hear us? What if they come here for us too?
Casey: Let them come; I’ll make sure they regret every second they spent ignoring us.

Drew: I packed the car in silence because I couldn’t look at you without screaming.
Reese: Please don’t raise your voice; my hands won’t stop shaking if you do.
Drew: You think a fresh start fixes this? You’re just running away again.
Reese: It’s not running, it’s surviving... I can’t breathe in that house anymore.
Drew: You’re leaving me behind to rot in the mess you made, and you have the nerve to call it survival.
Reese: I’m terrified that if we stay, I’ll vanish completely, and I don’t want to die there.
Drew: Fine, take your fear and drive it out of my life, just don’t expect me to forgive you.

Alex: You knew the deadline was today, yet you handed me this garbage ten minutes ago.
Sam: I-I’m sorry, the data wasn’t ready, I tried my best, please don’t fire me.
Alex: Don’t tell me you tried; look at these numbers, they’re completely wrong.
Sam: I’ll fix them right now, I swear, just don’t yell at me like that.
Alex: Fix them? You think a quick edit covers up your negligence for the whole team?
Sam: I was scared to ask for help because you seemed so busy, I didn’t want to bother you.
Alex: Well, you’ve certainly bothered me now, and trust is gone.
Sam: Please, I need this job, my family depends on it.
Alex: Get out of my sight before I call HR myself.

Quinn: Pack your bags, and do it now.
Avery: P-please, give me a moment to breathe.
Quinn: There is no time for breathing, there is only moving.
Avery: I can’t... my hands are shaking too much to zip this.
Quinn: Then use your teeth, I don't care how you get it done.
Avery: You’re looking at me like I’m already gone.
Quinn: Keep your eyes on the road, not on me.

Casey: Do you have any idea what you just did?!
Morgan: P-please, just lower your voice, I can't breathe.
Casey: Lower my voice? You handed over the client files to the competition!
Morgan: I didn't mean to, I was confused, please don't hurt me.
Casey: Confused? You were careless, and now my career is in ruins!
Morgan: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, please don't fire me, I have kids.
Casey: This isn't about firing you, this is about the fact that you destroyed everything.

Jordan: You’re telling me we’re going to the coast? After everything I sacrificed?
Riley: P-please, just lower your voice, you’re scaring me.
Jordan: I should be the one terrified, knowing you have the audacity to even suggest it.
Riley: I didn’t mean to upset you, I just thought it would help us...
Jordan: Help us? You help nothing but your own selfish desire to run away.
Riley: I’m sorry, I’ll fix it, just please don’t look at me like that.
Jordan: It’s too late for apologies, Riley, because I’m done listening to your excuses.
Jordan: Pack your bags. You’re not going anywhere with me.

Casey: Do you have any idea how long I’ve been standing here staring at this smoking engine?
Morgan: I-I’m sorry, please don’t shout, I’m just trying to help.
Casey: Help? You mean standing there shaking like a leaf while I lose my mind?
Morgan: I didn’t know the belt would snap like that, I promise I didn’t mean to break it.
Casey: You didn’t mean to break my patience either, but here we are.
Morgan: I’ll call a tow truck, just please keep your voice down, my heart can’t take this.
Casey: Call whoever you want, because I’m not moving an inch until this mess is sorted.

Quinn: Did you see his face? He didn't even blink while he threatened to ruin everything.
Avery: Please, stop looking at me like that. I can’t breathe in here.
Quinn: You should be listening, not hiding. He knows where we live now.
Avery: I didn’t mean to pick up. I swear I didn’t know it was him.
Quinn: Your ignorance is a luxury we can’t afford. Pack a bag.
Avery: But where can we go? He’s everywhere.
Quinn: We go nowhere until I decide we’re safe enough to move.
Quinn: Don’t make a sound, or he’ll come back for both of us.

Casey: I told you a thousand times I won’t move into that crumbling dump.
Morgan: Please, just lower your voice, they can hear us from the street.
Casey: I don’t care who hears me because I refuse to be trapped in that suffocating box.
Morgan: Shh, stop shouting, you’re making me shake.
Casey: I’m shaking because I’m furious at how you’re ignoring every warning sign.
Morgan: I’m just trying to keep us safe from people who don’t like loud arguments.
Casey: Then find a place where I can scream without you begging for silence.

Alex: You’re telling me the server crashed five minutes before the demo, and you didn’t call?
Sam: I-I was trying to fix it, I really was, please don’t yell at me.
Alex: Trying? I paid you to deliver, not to try while the clock ran out.
Sam: It wasn’t my fault, the code was corrupted, I’m so sorry, I’ll stay late, just please—
Alex: Late won’t bring back the client’s trust, Sam, look at me when I’m speaking to you.
Sam: I can’t... my hands are shaking, I didn’t know it would be this bad, I’ll fix everything tonight.
Alex: Tonight? You think tonight saves us after you blew the window open like an idiot?
Sam: I don’t know what to do anymore, I’m terrified you’re going to fire me right now.

Quinn: I’ve never seen someone so disrespectful in my entire life.
Avery: Please, just don’t shout, they might hear you.
Quinn: I told them exactly where they stand, and they hung up on me!
Avery: Your voice is shaking... please put the phone down.
Quinn: They think they can just walk all over me?
Avery: I’m terrified, Quinn, please calm down before you hurt yourself.
Quinn: I’m not done with them yet, not by a long shot.

Taylor: Do you have any idea what you’ve done to us?
Jamie: Please, Taylor, I didn’t know they would see it.
Taylor: You didn’t know? You signed off on the leak!
Jamie: I was just following the protocol, I swear.
Taylor: Protocol doesn’t stop the board from firing us.
Jamie: I’m shaking, I can’t breathe, I’ll fix it.
Taylor: Fix it? There is no fixing this mess.
Taylor: Get out of my sight before I scream.

Alex: You think this is a joke? You think I’m just going to sit here while you burn everything down?
Sam: P-please, just listen, I didn’t mean to hurt you, I was scared!
Alex: Scared? You should be terrified of what I’m capable of when you push me this far.
Sam: I won’t go anywhere, just don’t look at me like that, please.
Alex: Don’t tell me what to do, you coward, you never had the guts to face the truth.
Sam: I’m trying, I’m really trying, but I can’t breathe when you shout like that.
Alex: Good. Maybe if you can’t breathe, you’ll finally start to feel something real.

Taylor: Stop packing those boxes, I swear to god I will throw them out the window myself.
Jamie: Please, don’t shout, the walls are so thin here and I can’t handle any more noise right now.
Taylor: Thin walls? You’re worried about neighbors while we’re uprooting our entire lives on a whim!
Jamie: I’m trying to be careful, Taylor, please just let me finish without yelling at me.
Taylor: Careful? You call this careful? You’re just running away and dragging me along for the ride.
Jamie: My hands are shaking so hard I can barely tie this tape, I just want it to be over.
Taylor: Well it’s not over until I say it is, and I’m not saying it until you explain this disaster.
Jamie: I can’t... I just can’t breathe when you look at me like that.
Taylor: Then don’t look at me, just keep packing before I lose what little patience I have left.

Jordan: I can’t believe he did this after everything we put into helping him.
Riley: Please, lower your voice... you’re making a scene.
Jordan: A scene? He betrayed our trust, and I’m going to make sure everyone knows it.
Riley: If you go public with this, he might do something desperate.
Jordan: Desperate? He’s already done the damage; I’m just cleaning up the mess.
Riley: You don’t understand how unstable he is right now. I’m scared for all of us.
Jordan: Fear isn’t going to fix his lies, but the truth will set us free.

Jordan: You think you can just wipe the slate clean like I don't see what you did?
Riley: Please, Jordan, don't shout, I’m shaking here, I didn’t mean for it to go this far.
Jordan: I meant for it to stay safe, and you handed it over to them because you were too scared to ask.
Riley: I was terrified of losing everything, I thought if I just gave them what they wanted, they’d leave us alone.
Jordan: Alone? You left me alone to deal with the debt while you sat there silent!
Riley: I can pay it back, I swear on my life, just please don’t make me go to the police.
Jordan: You already did that by signing those papers, so stop begging and start fixing what you broke.
Jordan: Don't look at me with those wet eyes, I want the full amount in my account by noon.

Taylor: You think I’m just going to let you drain what’s left?
Jamie: Please, just listen, it’s not like that, I’m scared too.
Taylor: Scared? I’m the one holding the pieces of a shattered life!
Jamie: I didn’t know it would get this bad, I promise I’ll fix it.
Taylor: Fix it? You broke it when you signed those papers behind my back!
Jamie: It was the only way, I thought you’d understand by now.
Taylor: Understand? I should have cut you out before you bled us dry.

Drew: I saw the headline, and I want to tear that paper out of existence.
Reese: Please, lower your voice; they could hear you from the hallway.
Drew: Let them hear! Let everyone know what a monster he really is!
Reese: If you make a scene, you’ll only draw more attention to yourself.
Drew: I don’t care about safety, I care about justice for what he did.
Reese: You’re playing with fire, Drew; look at my hands, they won’t stop shaking.
Drew: Then grab a gun, because I’m not letting this slide one second longer.

Alex: I don’t care if it’s raining, we are driving through that pass tonight.
Sam: Please, just... look at the forecast, the roads will be ice.
Alex: I said we are going, and I won't hear another word of hesitation.
Sam: My hands are shaking too hard to even hold my phone, Alex.
Alex: Stop acting like a child and get in the car, now.
Sam: I can’t do this, I’m terrified of what might happen out there.
Alex: Then you’d better start praying because I’m not turning this car around.

Alex: Do you have any idea how much time I spent earning that?
Sam: P-please, just let’s not raise our voices, okay?
Alex: Not raise our voices? You took it without asking!
Sam: I thought... I thought you wouldn't notice, I was so scared you'd leave.
Alex: You didn't ask because you knew I'd say no, you took it because you didn't care.
Sam: I didn't mean to hurt you, I just needed the space, please don't look at me like that.
Alex: Keep your hands where I can see them, and do not move until I'm done speaking.

Casey: I’m not even going to ask how this happened again.
Morgan: P-please, just don’t raise your voice, Casey, I’m begging you.
Casey: My voice is fine. It’s the sheer incompetence that’s making me scream inside.
Morgan: I can fix it. I promise I can fix it, just please don’t look at me like that.
Casey: You had twenty-four hours to double-check the files. Twenty-four hours.
Morgan: I know, I know, I messed up, I’m so sorry, I’m terrified I’m going to lose everything.
Casey: Then start packing your desk, because I’m done cleaning up your mess.

Drew: I’m not packing a single box until you admit this whole trip was a mistake.
Reese: Please, just keep your voice down, they might hear us from the hallway.
Drew: Let them hear! Let them see how you’ve sold out our entire life for some shiny, empty promise!
Reese: I can’t breathe like this, the walls feel like they’re closing in on us.
Drew: You’re shaking? Good. You should be shaking. You threw away everything we built.
Reese: I only wanted us to be safe, Drew, I didn’t know it would turn into this nightmare.
Drew: Safety doesn’t look like this, it looks like burning bridges and screaming into the void.
Drew: So get in the car, because I’m not stopping for anyone else.

Casey: Did you hear how he laughed at me? Like I was nothing.
Morgan: Please, just put the phone down, your hands are shaking so hard.
Casey: I’m going to call him back and scream until his ears bleed.
Morgan: Don’t do it, Casey, you’ll get us both killed, please stop.
Casey: He thinks he can just walk all over me? No.
Morgan: I can’t breathe, look at me, I’m begging you, stay here.
Casey: I’m dialing right now, and there’s nothing you can do to stop me.

Drew: You think he’s just gone? I saw the way he looked at me before he left. He knew.
Reese: Please, stop shouting. You’re making me shake. I don’t know what happened.
Drew: Don’t give me that blank stare. You were with him. You know exactly what he did.
Reese: I didn’t see anything! If you keep pushing, you’ll make it worse for everyone.
Drew: Worse? It’s already ruined. He betrayed us, Reese. He betrayed me.
Reese: I’m trying to protect us from what comes next. Just let it go, please.
Drew: I’m not letting it go until I tear the truth out of him, no matter where he is hiding.

Alex: You don't get to decide that, Sam. Not now.
Sam: I-I’m sorry, please, it was the only way.
Alex: The only way? You think you can just rewrite reality when it suits you?
Sam: I didn’t mean to hurt you, I was just trying to fix it.
Alex: Fix it? You broke everything we had!
Sam: Please, Alex, just listen to me, don’t look at me like that.
Alex: I’m done listening. Get out of my sight.

Jordan: You did not think to tell me before you canceled the reservation?
Riley: I-I’m so sorry, Jordan, please don’t look at me like that.
Jordan: Like what? Like someone who actually gives a damn?
Riley: The weather turned bad, I was just trying to keep us safe, I’m shaking...
Jordan: Safe? I’m standing here holding a gift you didn’t even want, trembling with rage.
Riley: I’ll fix it, I promise, just please stop raising your voice.
Jordan: Too late for promises, Riley, get out of my sight.

Quinn: Did you actually think I wouldn't notice you burned the rice again?
Avery: I-I’m sorry, the smoke alarm didn't go off, I didn't mean—
Quinn: You didn't mean to ruin my favorite pot? Or did you just decide my patience is worthless?
Avery: Please, just let me fix it, I’ll order pizza, I’ll do whatever you want.
Quinn: Whatever I want? You think you can buy your way out of this incompetence?
Avery: I’m shaking, Quinn, please don’t yell, I’m trying so hard to be good.
Quinn: Good isn't good enough when you treat my house like a joke.

Casey: Just pick something, damn it, I don't have the patience for your silence anymore.
Morgan: I... I can't think, Casey, please don't raise your voice, it makes my chest hurt.
Casey: Don't tell me what I'm doing, just look at me and decide if we're staying in or going out.
Morgan: I don't want to go out, I don't want to stay in, I just want the shouting to stop.
Casey: You think you have a choice right now? You think this is a game we're playing?
Morgan: I'm scared of you, please, just let me go to the room.
Casey: No, you're going to sit right there and answer me, or so help me, I'll drag you out myself.

Alex: Do you have any idea what time it is?
Sam: I... I just needed a few more hours, please.
Alex: A few more hours? We launch in thirty minutes!
Sam: I’m sorry, my hands are shaking so bad I can’t even type.
Alex: Stop trembling and start working, right now.
Sam: I tried, I really did, but the code won’t hold together.
Alex: Then it doesn’t matter if it works, it matters that it’s done.

Taylor: Did you hear what he did? I can’t believe I ever trusted him with a damn thing.
Jamie: Please, keep your voice down. If anyone hears us, they’ll know.
Taylor: Let them know! He ruined everything and he’s probably laughing right now.
Jamie: No, you have to stop. He’s dangerous, Taylor. Truly dangerous.
Taylor: Dangerous? He’s a liar and a thief, and I’m going to make sure he pays.
Jamie: You can’t confront him. Not yet. Not while he’s still watching us.
Taylor: I don’t care if he’s watching. I’m done being polite.

Quinn: STOP touching the engine! You’re going to make it worse!
Avery: I... I just wanted to help, please don’t yell at me.
Quinn: HELP? You can’t even hold a wrench without shaking!
Avery: My hands are cold, I’m sorry, I didn’t mean to drop it.
Quinn: It doesn’t matter what you meant, it matters that this is ruined!
Avery: Please, just... please stop looking at me like that.
Quinn: Get out of the car, now, before I make you leave.

Casey: You think I’m just going to pack up our lives and leave?
Morgan: Please, Casey, I can’t handle this, I’m shaking right now.
Casey: You’re shaking because you’re weak, not because it’s hard.
Morgan: It’s not weakness, it’s terror, every road leads to the wrong place.
Casey: Stop cowering, we are moving forward whether you like it or not.
Morgan: I can’t breathe when you talk to me like that, it’s too much.
Casey: Then learn to hold your breath, because I’m done waiting.

Quinn: I’m done with this game, so stop stalling and tell me why we can’t just buy the fixer-upper on Elm.
Avery: P-please, just... lower your voice, I can’t handle another one of these shouting matches.
Quinn: You’re terrified of a little hard work, but I won’t let your cowardice dictate our future again.
Avery: It’s not about work, it’s about safety, and you’re scaring me with that look in your eyes.
Quinn: Safety is a luxury we don’t have, and your weakness is the only thing standing between us and what we deserve.
Avery: I’m shaking, Quinn, please don’t come closer, I need you to just listen to me for once.
Quinn: Listen? I’m sick of listening, so pack your bags because we’re moving into that house whether you like it or not.

Taylor: Do not dare tell me we are staying home again.
Jamie: Please, Taylor, look at the sky, it’s completely dark out there.
Taylor: I booked that restaurant three months ago, Jamie, I do not take kindly to being ignored.
Jamie: The roads are flooded, I’m not risking us getting trapped in the car.
Taylor: Your fear is not my problem, and your excuses are even less acceptable.
Jamie: I just want us to be safe, please don’t shout at me like this.
Taylor: Safety is for people who have the courage to follow through on their commitments.

Alex: I want the files on my desk right now, not in an hour.
Sam: I-I’m trying, please, just give me five more minutes.
Alex: Five minutes? You had five days to get this done!
Sam: My computer crashed, I swear I didn’t mean to delay you.
Alex: Don’t you dare lie to my face, Sam.
Sam: I’ll work through the night, please don’t fire me.
Alex: Fix it now, or walk out that door.

Casey: Stop touching the knife, Morgan, or I swear I will break every dish in this kitchen.
Morgan: Please, just let me chop the onions, I’m begging you, I can’t bear the silence anymore.
Casey: You don’t get to decide what happens here, not tonight, not ever again.
Morgan: I’ll do whatever you want, just don’t look at me like that, please.
Casey: Your pathetic trembling makes my skin crawl, move away from the counter.
Morgan: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, I’ll leave if that’s what you need, just tell me to go.
Casey: Sit down and shut up while I make this dinner alone.

Quinn: Pack your bag. We leave in ten minutes, and if you're not ready, I'm going without you.
Avery: Please, just give me five more minutes, I can't leave like this, not without talking to them.
Quinn: I don't care about "them," I care about getting out of this hellhole before I scream.
Avery: You're not listening to me, Quinn, if we go now, everything falls apart, please, just wait.
Quinn: Everything is already falling apart because you hesitate while the clock ticks down!
Avery: I'm begging you, don't make me choose between this and losing my mind, just stop.
Quinn: The car is running, so decide if you're coming or if you want me to burn this place down.

Jordan: You had better have a damn good reason for this.
Riley: Please, just listen, I didn't have a choice!
Jordan: You always say that when you screw up, but this isn't a mistake, this is betrayal.
Riley: I’m begging you, don't walk away, I’ll fix it, I swear I’ll make it right.
Jordan: Fix it? You destroyed everything we built in one selfish move.
Riley: I know, I know, but if you leave now, there’s nothing left for us.
Jordan: There hasn't been anything left for a long time.
Jordan: Stay out of my sight.

Taylor: Do you have any idea how many times I’ve asked you for the final draft?
Jamie: I know, I swear I’ve been working on it all night, my hands are literally shaking right now.
Taylor: Your shaking doesn’t change the fact that the client is waiting for me in an hour.
Jamie: Please, just give me two more hours, I’ll send it immediately, I beg you.
Taylor: Two hours isn’t an option, Jamie, this is a disaster I didn’t sign up for.
Jamie: If you send it without me, we both fail, I’m terrified of losing this job.
Taylor: You lost this moment the second you missed the deadline yesterday.

Alex: Just tell me why this junk heap won't start for the third time this week!
Sam: I don't know, I just tried everything I could think of, please, I'm begging you.
Alex: Stop shaking and look at me when I'm talking to you!
Sam: I am looking, I'm just so tired of failing you, I can't breathe right now.
Alex: You think your tiredness fixes the engine? It doesn't!
Sam: I'll call the tow truck, I'll pay for it, just please don't yell at me anymore.
Alex: Keep your money, just get out of my sight before I lose it completely.
Sam: I'm going, I'm gone, just let me leave.
Alex: Good.

Alex: I can’t believe they just left us hanging like that after everything we did for them.
Sam: Please, just don’t make a scene, I’m begging you, they’re already in enough trouble.
Alex: Trouble? They betrayed my trust, Sam, and I won’t sit here and let them walk away unscathed.
Sam: If you confront them now, it will only make things worse, I’m terrified of what might happen.
Alex: Terrified? You should be angry, not cowering while they destroy our friendship.
Sam: I’m trying to keep us from burning everything down, please, just let it go.
Alex: Let it go? No, I want them to know exactly what they’ve lost.

Alex: Put the knife down, Sam, and step away from the counter right now.
Sam: Please, I just need to get this right, I can’t mess this up again, not after everything.
Alex: You messed up the schedule, you messed up the budget, and you’re about to mess up my patience.
Sam: I’m trying to fix it, I swear, just let me finish chopping before you explode.
Alex: I don’t want your food, I want an apology for the chaos you bring into my home.
Sam: I’m begging you, just watch me work, please give me one chance to make this perfect.
Alex: There is nothing perfect here, only your inability to control yourself, so move.

Jordan: You want to move into that moldy basement? Are you trying to kill us?
Riley: Please, Jordan, it’s the only thing we can afford before the eviction notice becomes real.
Jordan: I will not let you live in a hole in the ground like an animal.
Riley: If we don’t sign tonight, we have nowhere to go at all, so just sign it.
Jordan: This is insulting, treating my safety like a bargaining chip.
Riley: I’m begging you, look at my hands, they’re shaking, just help me here.
Jordan: I help by refusing to let you throw your life away on trash.
Riley: Then tell me what to do, because I’m already breaking.
Jordan: We find something honest, or we stay here and fight for it properly.

Alex: You had one job, Sam, and you threw it in the trash like it was nothing.
Sam: I didn't throw it away, I just... I needed the cash before the eviction notice came.
Alex: So you gambled my life savings on a whim because you were too lazy to work?
Sam: Please, just don't yell, I can fix this, I swear I can make it back by Friday.
Alex: Fix it? You burned the bridge, Sam, and now we're standing in the ashes.
Sam: I’m begging you, just give me another chance, I have nowhere else to go.
Alex: No, you have nowhere else to go because you made sure of it.
Alex: Pack your bags, because I’m not moving forward with a dead weight.

Quinn: Do you have any idea what time it is? The server locks at midnight, Avery. Midnight.
Avery: I know, I know, please, just give me ten more minutes, my laptop crashed and I’m rebuilding the database from scratch.
Quinn: You had three days. Three days to fix what should have taken three hours.
Avery: I’m begging you, if I don’t get this in, I lose my internship, I lose everything, please don’t submit it without me.
Quinn: I don’t care about your internship; I care that I’m not covering for your incompetence again.
Avery: Just one minute, I swear on my life, the files are almost ready, please.
Quinn: No. I’m hitting send right now, and you can explain it to the director.
Avery: Wait, please!

Alex: Did you hear that tone? Pure, unadulterated mockery.
Sam: Please, Alex, just put the phone down before you break it.
Alex: I’m going to call them back right now and scream until my throat bleeds.
Sam: You can’t do that, they’ll cut us off completely, we’re begging here!
Alex: Begging? They don’t deserve a single drop of our mercy.
Sam: If we lose this contract, everything falls apart, I’m scared!
Alex: Let it all burn to the ground, I’m done swallowing this poison.

Jordan: You can’t be serious right now; I am done compromising on safety for the sake of your ego.
Riley: Please, just look at the listing, we have nowhere else to go and the bank is calling again.
Jordan: Nowhere else? We have money, Riley, stop acting like we’re about to sleep in a cardboard box.
Riley: I’m begging you, just sign the lease, I can’t handle one more night of panic.
Jordan: I won’t put my head under a pillow that smells like mildew and desperation.
Riley: It’s warm, it’s quiet, and it’s the only thing keeping us from the street, so please!
Jordan: You are scaring me, stop shouting and start making a real plan.
Riley: I can’t breathe if we don’t move today, just say yes.
Jordan: I’m not saying yes to a trap, and I’m certainly not saying yes to you begging me like this.

Casey: They think they can just walk away after stealing that money? I’m going to make sure they regret the day they were born.
Morgan: Please, Casey, you have to stop, they’re terrified and begging for their life, they didn’t mean any of it.
Casey: Begging? They’re begging while I’m paying for their mistakes, I don’t care if they scream until their lungs give out.
Morgan: You’re going to destroy them completely, and then what? You’ll have nothing left but this hate eating you alive too.
Casey: At least I’ll have the satisfaction of watching them pay for what they did, something you’re too weak to even consider.
Morgan: I’m trying to save us all from the ruin that follows violence, please, just put the phone down and let this go.
Casey: I won’t put it down, and I won’t let them go, because they owe me everything.

Taylor: Do you have any idea how much trust I’ve lost in your ability to deliver on time?
Jamie: Please, I’m begging you, just give me one more hour, I’m tearing my hair out here.
Taylor: One more hour won’t fix the fact that you’ve ignored every single reminder I sent.
Jamie: I know, I know, but I’m literally sitting here with nothing but empty code and panic.
Taylor: Panic isn’t a deliverable, Jamie, and neither is your apology.
Jamie: I’ll work through the night, I swear on my life, just don’t tell the client yet.
Taylor: You swore that yesterday, and look where that got us.
Taylor: The report goes out in ten minutes, finished or not, so get it done.

Taylor: I told you this was non-negotiable, and now you’re just brushing it off like I’m some joke you can walk away from?
Jamie: Please, Taylor, just listen to me for one second because I am literally crumbling here.
Taylor: Don’t you dare beg me when you’ve already made your choice, Jamie.
Jamie: I didn’t have a choice! If I don’t go, I lose everything, and I can’t lose you too.
Taylor: You lost me the moment you decided your career mattered more than your word.
Jamie: It’s not about that, I swear, I’ll make it up to you, I’ll do anything, just don’t shut the door.
Taylor: The door isn’t just closed, Jamie, it’s locked.

Alex: Don't touch that knife unless you want to lose your thumb, I said move.
Sam: Please, just let me help, I can't take another night of eating cold leftovers.
Alex: I didn't ask for your pity, I asked for silence while I try to focus.
Sam: It’s not pity, it’s desperation, I’m starving and I’m breaking.
Alex: Then starve, because your shaking hands are ruining the sauce.
Sam: Look at me, just look at me, I’m begging you to let me in.
Alex: Get out of my kitchen before I make you leave.

Drew: Do you have any idea how long I stood there staring at that blank screen?
Reese: Please, Drew, I was hyperventilating, I couldn't even remember how to lift my hand.
Drew: You couldn't lift your hand, but you could take three days to return a text?
Reese: I was terrified of saying the wrong thing, terrified of losing you, I was drowning.
Drew: Drowning doesn't explain why you left me hanging on the line for an hour.
Reese: I was trying to find my voice, I was scrambling for something, anything, to make it right.
Drew: Well, you failed, and I'm done waiting for you to figure it out.
Reese: Don't walk away, please, just give me one more chance.
Drew: There are no more chances when you treat my time like it means nothing.

Casey: "Tell me one more time why this car is still dead, and I swear I will dismantle it with my bare hands!"
Morgan: "Please, just stop shouting, I can’t breathe when you yell like that."
Casey: "I’m not yelling, I’m screaming at the incompetence of this whole situation!"
Morgan: "I tried everything, I really did, but I don’t know what to do next."
Casey: "Then call a tow truck, because I am done standing here while you panic."
Morgan: "I can’t afford a tow truck, Casey, I have no money left, please help me."
Casey: "Well, that’s your problem to solve, not mine."
Casey: "Now get out of my way before I push you out of it."

Jordan: Don’t touch that knife unless you want me to break every bone in your hand.
Riley: Please, just... I’ll do it my way, I promise, just let me fix this before it’s too late.
Jordan: You don’t get to fix anything, you only know how to make a mess of everything I try to build.
Riley: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, just give me one more chance, I beg you.
Jordan: You had your chance the moment you walked in here with that smug look on your face.
Riley: I didn’t mean to upset you, I just wanted to help, please don’t hate me.
Jordan: Hate you? I can’t even stand to breathe the same air as your incompetence anymore.
Jordan: Get out of my kitchen, right now, before I make you.

Jordan: You don't get to stand there and look at me with those watery eyes after what you did.
Riley: Please, just hear me out, I swear I had no idea it would end up like this.
Jordan: No idea? You lied to my face, Riley, you looked me in the eye and you lied.
Riley: I was trying to protect us! I didn't want you to hate them, I just wanted everyone to be happy.
Jordan: Happy? You destroyed their career for your own selfish peace of mind.
Riley: I’m begging you, I’ll fix it, I’ll call them right now, just don’t walk away.
Jordan: You can call them, you can grovel, but don't you dare expect me to forgive you.
Jordan: Stay out of my life until you learn the difference between loyalty and betrayal.

Jordan: You’re late again, and the onions are already burning.
Riley: I’m so sorry, I just... I had no choice but to stop for milk.
Jordan: You always have a choice, Riley, yet you never choose me.
Riley: Please, just let me fix this, I’ll burn the whole thing if I have to, just don’t look at me like that.
Jordan: Look at you? I’m looking at the mess you’ve made of everything we touch.
Riley: I’ll clean it, I’ll cook, I’ll do whatever you want, just tell me what to do.
Jordan: You can’t clean this up with words, and you certainly can’t cook away the silence between us.

Quinn: I told you that this would happen, but did you listen? No, you just looked away.
Avery: Please, Quinn, you have to help me figure out what to do next.
Quinn: I’m done doing the heavy lifting for people who treat my patience like a joke.
Avery: I’m shaking here, I don’t know where to turn, just tell me how to fix this.
Quinn: You don’t get to break everything and then ask me to glue it back together.
Avery: If you walk away now, there’s literally nothing left for me to hold onto.
Quinn: Then let it fall, because I’m not catching it this time.

Quinn: I’m not going anywhere, and I’m certainly not spending my Saturday listening to you beg.
Avery: Please, just listen, I can fix this, I’ll drive, I’ll pay for everything, just don’t shut me out.
Quinn: You think money or convenience erases what you did? You think I’m a switch you can just flip back on?
Avery: I know I messed up, I know I’m an idiot, but if you go to the lake, we can start over, I swear on my life.
Quinn: Start over? You don’t get to reset the clock because your guilt is getting heavy.
Avery: Just five minutes, Quinn, let me prove I can be better, don’t let this be the end of us.
Quinn: It’s already over; get out of my sight before I say something I can’t take back.

Jordan: Just hand me the wrench, and don't you dare drop it this time.
Riley: Please, I’m trying, my hands are shaking so bad I can’t even hold the tool steady.
Jordan: If you drop that bolt into the engine block, I swear I will lose my mind completely.
Riley: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, just tell me what to do and I’ll do it right, I promise.
Jordan: You promise? You promised last time and look where we are, stuck in the rain.
Riley: I know, I know, but if you just breathe, we can fix this, please don't yell at me.
Jordan: I’m not yelling, I’m screaming internally because you keep missing the obvious screw.
Riley: I see it, I see it, hold on, just give me three seconds.

Drew: You have twelve hours to fix this mess, and I don’t care if you have to sleep on the floor to do it.
Reese: Please, just give me until tomorrow morning, I haven’t slept in two days and my hands are shaking.
Drew: My hands are shaking too, but that’s because I’m ready to throw this laptop through a window if I see one more error.
Reese: I’m begging you, Drew, if you fire me now, I literally won’t know where to go.
Drew: Then figure it out fast, because my patience evaporated the second you missed the last checkpoint.
Reese: I’ll work through the night, I promise, just don’t shut the door on me.
Drew: The door stays open, but if that file isn’t perfect by sunrise, you’re walking out it yourself.

Drew: Don't touch the knife, Reese, just stay exactly where you are.
Reese: Please, I just need to help, I can't sit here while you do everything again.
Drew: I told you to stay back, so why are you still moving toward the counter?
Reese: Because if I don't do something, I feel like I'm disappearing into the walls.
Drew: You're not disappearing, you're being reckless and it's making me sick.
Reese: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, just let me chop the onions, please.
Drew: Get out of the kitchen before I say something I can't take back.

Jordan: Did you hear the venom in that voice?
Riley: Please, Jordan, just let me explain why I had to pick up.
Jordan: I don’t want your reasons; I want an apology for disrespecting me.
Riley: I’m begging you, don’t do this, not when we’re already falling apart.
Jordan: We fell apart the second you chose them over my trust.
Riley: I didn’t choose them, I was terrified of losing you, so I panicked!
Jordan: Your panic is a luxury I’m no longer willing to subsidize.

Jordan: Don’t even bother suggesting dinner; I’m not hungry for your excuses.
Riley: Please, just give me five minutes, I can fix this, I promise I can.
Jordan: You’ve had weeks to fix it, and look where that got us.
Riley: I’m begging you, don’t walk away, anything is better than silence.
Jordan: Silence is the only thing you’ve earned by lying to my face.
Riley: I’ll do whatever you say, just don’t leave me here alone like this.
Jordan: You’re not alone, you’re just finally facing the consequences.
Riley: I’ll call them right now, I’ll apologize, just stay!
Jordan: No, stay here and rot in the mess you made.

Drew: Move your hand off that knife before you accidentally slice your own thumb off.
Reese: Please, just let me help with the garlic, I can’t watch you stand there in silence anymore.
Drew: I don’t want your help, I want you to leave the kitchen and stop breathing so loudly.
Reese: If I walk out that door, I don’t think I’ll ever come back, and I can’t lose you like this.
Drew: Then stay out of my way while I chop these vegetables without breaking them into pieces.
Reese: I’m trying, I’m really trying, but your voice makes my chest feel like it’s collapsing.
Drew: Then go to your room and wait for dinner to be ready, because I won’t cook with you hovering.
Reese: Drew, please just look at me.

Drew: Stop touching the engine with those shaking hands, you’re going to make it worse.
Reese: Please, Drew, I’m trying, I’m so scared we’re going to be stranded here forever.
Drew: Scared? You should be terrified because you just stripped the last bolt I trusted you to hold.
Reese: I didn’t mean to, I’m begging you, just tell me what to do, I’ll do anything.
Drew: Anything? Then get out of my way and let me fix the mess you made.

Jordan: I can’t breathe in this apartment, the walls are literally closing in on me right now.

Taylor: I can’t breathe, the phone’s ringing in my head, did you hear? Did you hear what happened to Alex?

Taylor: It doesn’t matter, it doesn’t matter, I’m shaking, I need to know everything right now.

Taylor: But if I don’t say it out loud, it might not be real, it feels like a nightmare I can’t wake up from.
Jamie: It is real, yes, but panic won’t change the facts, only your ability to cope with them.
Taylor: I just feel like I’m falling apart, like the ground is disappearing beneath my feet.
Jamie: Then sit down, feel the chair beneath you, and let me hold the weight for a moment.

Quinn: My hands won't stop shaking; I haven't slept in three days and the code is still broken.
Avery: Take a slow breath with me; the sky is still blue and the coffee is warm.
Quinn: I can't breathe, Avery, the timer is ticking louder than my heartbeat right now.

Quinn: If I don't fix this bug in ten minutes, everything I've worked for collapses.
Avery: You have fixed impossible things before, and you will fix this one too.
Quinn: I don't feel like I can think straight, but I'll try one more thing.

Jordan: Please, you have to decide right now, my head is spinning and I can’t take another second of this silence.
Riley: Breathe in for four counts, Jordan, let the air fill your lungs completely before you speak again.
Jordan: There’s no time for breathing exercises when the world is closing in and we’re just sitting here!

Jordan: It feels like an eternity, I’m suffocating in this waiting, tell me what we’re going to do!
Riley: We are going to sit, watch the dust motes dance in the light, and let the evening arrive on its own terms.
Jordan: I can’t just sit, I need action, I need something to happen before I completely unravel.

Taylor: Did you hear? They’re gone. Just like that.
Jamie: I heard. I sat in the silence for hours, waiting for my phone to ring.

Taylor: I need to fix this. I’ll call the doctors, I’ll check the records, I won’t stop.

Jordan: Please, I can’t go through with this, my hands won’t stop shaking.

Jordan: I’m sorry, I’m so sorry, I just need to breathe.

Alex: Please, just tell me it’s fixable, I can’t lose this, I literally cannot.
Sam: I’m sorry, Alex, it’s... it’s really bad news for me too.

Sam: I don’t know if there’s anything left to do, it feels like giving up already.

Casey: I can’t breathe, Morgan, tell me it’s not true, please, just lie to me!

Drew: I can’t do this, Reese, please, I’m begging you to let me out of it.

Alex: I can’t breathe in here, Sam; the interest just keeps rising like water in a sinking boat.

Alex: I can’t breathe, Sam; the clock is ticking and I have nothing to show for it.
